POINT_IDENTITY.tsv.rule: One row for each frozen source in each active point; token IDs restored from c3f625e4 receipt.

NATIVE_REQUEST_SAMPLES.tsv.rule: Arms GRAPH_ON_NATIVE and GRAPH_OFF_NATIVE only; one WARMUP and exactly three MEASURED rows per point/arm; preserve all individual values. Host wall is diagnostic.

NATIVE_REQUEST_SUMMARY.tsv.rule: Exactly eight rows, three measured samples per row; median of request-level CUDA-event values is primary.

GRAPH_MODE_CORRECTNESS.tsv.rule: All three arms per point; any required mismatch STOP_POINT. AWQ observed arm must match accepted V2 semantic/inventory receipt.

BACKEND_KERNEL_IDENTITY.tsv.rule: Actual runtime identity, not source capability alone; distinguish Graph ON and OFF.

SEMANTIC_INTERVALS.tsv.rule: GRAPH_OFF_OBSERVED only; AWQ observer has no per-occurrence CUDA Event. Host/NVTX chronology is not native timing.

CUDA_INTERVALS.tsv.rule: NSYS cuda,nvtx capture; overlapping intervals must be unioned before time fractions.

LAUNCH_GAPS.tsv.rule: Chronology only; gap classification is not a hardware bottleneck attribution.

NSYS_CAPTURE_INDEX.tsv.rule: At most one capture per point; GRAPH_OFF_OBSERVED; no NSYS wall in native estimator.

POINT_HEADROOM_SCREEN.tsv.rule: DQ1 f and S_zero are Graph-OFF CUDA-parent screening quantities, not automatically Graph-ON whole-run contribution. NA means not identifiable, never zero.

QUESTION_GATE_STATUS.tsv.rule: Only DQ1,DQ2,DQ3,DQ4a active; DQ4b and translation retained as deferred/inactive rows with no Tier0 promotion.

GPU_ACTIVE_BUDGET.json.rule: Total <=540 seconds and point caps 120,120,120,180; includes GPU-active load, correctness, warmup, measurement and NSYS.

FINAL_DECISION.json.rule: No science admission unless correctness, identity, publish and point budget gates pass.
